metadata.display_name: Retrieve Price Book Items (Price Book Items Crm Reads Api)
metadata.description: Retrieve a page of CRM objects of a specified type.
metadata.learn_more: Retrieve a page of CRM objects of a specified type. You can control the data returned by specifying properties, associations, and whether to include archived records. This endpoint is useful for fetching a list of objects with specific attributes or associations.

objectType.label: Object Type
objectType.description: The type of CRM object to retrieve, such as contacts, companies, or deals.

after.label: After
after.description: A cursor token for pagination. Use the value from the previous response's paging.next.after field.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Whether to include only results that have been archived. Defaults to false.

associations.label: Associations
associations.description: A comma-separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: The maximum number of results to display per page. Defaults to 10.

properties.label: Properties
properties.description: A comma-separated list of property names to include in the response. If any specified properties are not present on the requested objects, they will be ignored.

propertiesWithHistory.label: Properties With History
propertiesWithHistory.description: A comma-separated list of properties to return along with their history of previous values. If any specified properties are not present on the requested objects, they will be ignored. Using this parameter reduces the maximum number of objects that can be read in a single request.
